Class VideoGame

java.lang.Object
VideoGame
public class VideoGame extends Object
Steven Piskunov CEN-3024C - Software Development 1 October 30, 2026 VideoGame.java This class serves as the core domain model entity for the RetroVault DMS, encapsulating six distinct attributes for video games and defining mutator validation rules and mathematical valuation logic.

  • Constructor Details

    • VideoGame

      public VideoGame(int gameId, String title, String platform, double basePrice, int quantityInStock, boolean isCollectorEdition)
      Constructs a new VideoGame instance with specified identifiers, title, platform, pricing, stock, and edition.
      Parameters:
      gameId - the unique primary identifier for the game
      title - the title of the video game
      platform - the gaming platform or console
      basePrice - the baseline retail price in USD
      quantityInStock - the current inventory count
      isCollectorEdition - true if the game is a collector/special edition, false otherwise
